summary: Design refresh and assistant polish: follow-up questions now render inside the conversation directly below the answer instead of a fixed block covering it; the translation popover dismisses on any outside click; a layered surface/shadow scale plus accent rails and message/follow-up animations give blocks real separation; and selections render as a Cursor-style reference card (PDF icon, label, two-line snippet, remove) both above the input and attached to the user's message.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 353e69f. Static UI only; no model call.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation/layout work only; no model call and no budget/config change.
budget_impact.before: Fixed suggestion block could cover the answer; translation only closed via ✕/Esc; flat surfaces with little separation; plain chip citation.
budget_impact.after: Inline follow-ups under the answer; outside-click dismissal; layered surfaces/shadows and motion; Cursor-style reference cards.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; UI work, not recommendation quality

open_risks: The Dribbble reference could not be viewed; the refresh follows general modern-SaaS layering rather than that specific shot.
Reference cards are not yet clickable to jump back into the PDF.
Recommendation quality remains unproven; gates stay not_run.
